name: Supernova
description:
Supernova lets users bring governed data into Claude for business intelligence, SQL analysis and dashboard creation. Connect Claude to your organization's Supernova data lake to explore and query using SQL on your connected business data.

Claude can read and write your Git-backed analytics repository, create and review live dashboards, write data models and build a semantic model of your organization.

Use Supernova for questions about revenue, customers, subscriptions, product usage, customer support, marketing, operations and turn your business data into reusable SQL, analytical models, documentation or dashboards. 

Access is securely scoped through OAuth and data is stored encrypted using table-level encryption keys.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Supernova to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Supernova to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.supernova.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Supernova MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Supernova provides these MCP tools: connect_data, list_dashboards, list_files, list_repo_files, read_dashboard, read_file, read_repo_file, run_query, write_dashboard, and write_repo_file.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Supernova?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Supernova in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Supernova requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Supernova is developed by Supernova AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
